articles.summary: AI coding agents are remarkably good at producing designs that look complete and convincing. The harder question, especially in complex engineering work, is whether those designs will survive contact with the real world. Working on Jay (our new Jay web framework designed to help AI agents build production-ready websites), we use a strict design log methodology to catch exactly these problems: every significant feature is designed in writing, reviewed, and refined before implementation begins.
